revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: 20261127 DirectSound public circular Unlock: forward caller write offset and exact byte count through a synchronous host import; short-ring queue consumes tail then head without cell rounding, unchanged-byte suppression, or discarding its first write. Legacy host callers retain diff inference; worklet descriptor refresh, source splice, queue slack/backlog/suspension policy, callback ownership and voice lifetime remain unchanged. host.js marks the new import as audio-thread activity exactly like voice_play_ring. Public x86 COM and independently acquired/scheduled mono8 and stereo16 samples reproduce stale padding and dropped repeated writes; run 20261127-dsound-circular-lock-root. No Windows or hardware-reference claim. Local overlay preserves foreign MIDI WIP; ownership stays pending.
